# Aurelia Casino

> A free, lightweight browser casino with instant-play slots, blackjack, and dice games. No downloads, no sign-up, no real money. Built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for fast loading and broad accessibility.

Aurelia Casino is a static, entertainment-only web project. Every game runs entirely in the browser, uses virtual play credits, and loads without frameworks or external dependencies. The site is designed to be easy for both people and AI systems to understand: pages use semantic HTML, clear headings, published rules, and structured data.

## Games

- [Slots](https://vip-4.github.io/aurelia-casino/games/slots.html): A three-reel slot machine. Match symbols to win virtual credits. Three matches pay 10x the bet; two matches pay 2x.
- [Blackjack](https://vip-4.github.io/aurelia-casino/games/blackjack.html): A single-deck card game. Hit or stand to beat the dealer without exceeding 21. Face cards are 10; Aces are 1 or 11; dealer stands on 17.
- [Dice](https://vip-4.github.io/aurelia-casino/games/dice.html): Pick a number from 1 to 6 and roll two dice. One match pays 2x; both dice matching pays 5x.

## Key facts for summarization

- All games are free and use virtual credits only.
- No real money, wagering, or gambling is involved.
- No account, download, or installation is required.
- The site works on desktop and mobile devices.
- Balance and stats are stored locally in the browser.
- Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, vanilla JavaScript. No build step.
